message.content:
Beneath a sky of endless blue,  
A single thread of hope takes flight—  
A kite, a whisper in the wind,  
A fleeting dream that feels so right.

Its wings unfurl like painted sails,  
A dance of colors bright and bold;  
It arcs above the laughing hills,  
A story that the clouds have told.

The child who holds its string with care,  
Sees every gust as chance to soar;  
With every tug, the kite ascends,  
And leaves behind the world’s old lore.

It weaves through clouds like silver threads,  
A fleeting path across the air;  
Each loop and twist a fleeting breath,  
A moment caught in light’s affair.

When evening paints the horizon gold,  
The kite begins to glide and sway;  
It dips and dives, a graceful arc,  
Until it finds the earth’s embrace.

And when the day has slipped away,  
The kite will rest upon the ground;  
Yet in the heart of those who’ve seen,  
Its memory will always sound.

So let us lift our spirits high,  
Like kites that dance upon the breeze;  
For in each soaring, fleeting flight,  
We find the joy that sets us free.
